subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should OpenClaw expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` in shared user/workspace path resolution for skill install paths, and what should happen to missing or empty variables?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes config/path interpretation across more than ClawHub skill installs, so maintainers need to choose the compatibility and security semantics before landing or replacing the linked PR.

options.title: Adopt bounded resolver expansion
options.body: Expand known environment placeholders in the shared resolver, preserve unresolved placeholders or fail clearly, and cover ClawHub skill installs plus sibling path helpers with tests.

options.title: Keep paths literal
options.body: Document `$VAR` and `${VAR}` in OpenClaw path config as unsupported literals and direct Docker users to fully expanded absolute paths.

options.title: Fold into broader env policy
options.body: Defer this fix until the broader dotenv expansion policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38259 defines consistent trust-boundary semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded resolver expansion
recommendation.body: Expand known environment placeholders in the shared resolver, preserve unresolved placeholders or fail clearly, and cover ClawHub skill installs plus sibling path helpers with tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checkout routes the shared path resolver and affected install path through his recent history, making him the best available owner for the compatibility decision.
